text:
maya: Heads-up: deploybot will swap kernel+quant bundle (matmul-tiling-v3 / quant-int8-fix) into staging at 02:00 UTC. Requesting micro-canary (0.5%) and explicit rollback gates. Long-seq (>1.5k) risk noted.

liam: Please post SHA and a one-line RN blurb.

maya: sha: f00dbabe1234. rn: 'matmul-tiling v3 + int8 encoder fixes: improves cache locality for short seqs; monitor long-seq p95 and kv-cache evictions.'

olivia: Quick perf job queued. Short seq p50 -7%. Long seq 1536 p95 +11% on a subset; evict spikes visible. Link: /s/ci/tiling/789.

arjun: Canary plan: slice=0.5% for 30m, hold expansion. Rollback triggers: p95 > baseline*1.4 OR error rate delta >0.5pp OR kv-cache hitrate drop >3pp. Pin region=us-west-2 while canary active.

deploybot: DeployBot: queued matmul-tiling-v3 -> staging canary=0.5% start=02:00UTC region=us-west-2

maya: Ack. I'll set pin-ttl=6h and add a manual rollback button in console.

deploybot: DeployBot: canary started 02:01UTC -> active. Dash: /dash/eng/matmul-tiling-v3/canary

olivia: 02:06 short seq OK. 02:09 long-seq p95 ~1.45x baseline; kvcache hitrate -3.5pp. Meeting rollback gate.

liam: Recommend immediate pin and revert canary.

arjun: Agreed. deploybot, pin matmul-tiling-v2 -> staging region=us-west-2 reason='canary kv-hit drop & p95 regression'

deploybot: DeployBot: pin applied. Canary aborted and traffic reverted. Notifying release owner.

maya: Thanks all. Olivia please open a perf PR with tiling heuristics + seq=1536 regression test. We'll postpone prod rollout until a healthy 1% canary.

olivia: On it. Ill add CI night-smoke and the eviction trace to the PR.
